findings.description: Plan hard-coded crewsVersion == 1.7.1 but origin/main has 1.7.2.
findings.resolution: AC-8 now accepts any 1.7.x; plan headings reference 'crews v1.7.x (1.7.2 on origin/main 2026-05-28)'. preflight.json also captures the exact patch.

findings.description: POSIX shell syntax in ACs incompatible with Windows PowerShell.
findings.resolution: Plan now pins Git Bash explicitly: 'All verification commands assume Git Bash opened at D:/harness-efforts/codexu/.' AC text references awk/grep/test which are all Git-Bash-available.

findings.description: AC-11 unverifiable on lead's branch (has unrelated commits vs origin/main).
findings.resolution: Plan mandates topic branch `ralph/plugins-copilot-cross-engine-audit` cut off origin/main (constraint 6). AC-11 now verifies `git diff --name-only origin/main..ralph/plugins-copilot-cross-engine-audit`. AC-1 verifies the topic branch differs from the lead's branch.

findings.description: Parallel US-001..003 race on preflight.json + Copilot plugin install.
findings.resolution: Added serial US-000 preflight as phase-0 cluster. US-001..003 now read-only consume preflight.json; only US-003 mutates Copilot plugin cache. suggested-decomposition.json now has three clusters (preflight serial, per-plugin parallel, aggregation serial).

findings.description: No concrete CLI invocations for 'run /plan-with-ralph from Copilot' and 'invoke overview.parallel_ready_tasks via Copilot'.
findings.resolution: US-002 now uses concrete direct-Node smoke commands (e.g., `node <worktree>/plugins/ralph/src/codex-exec.mjs --help`; `bash <worktree>/plugins/ralph/codex-exec.sh --prompt … --output …`). US-003 specifies `copilot mcp list --json` from a scratch workspace with no .mcp.json, plus `copilot -p 'invoke overview.parallel_ready_tasks' --allow-all --silent` for the fallback path. End-to-end /plan-with-ralph is now marked OPTIONAL.

findings.description: Worktree vs installed-cache decision deferred to impl mid-execution.
findings.resolution: Constraint 7 makes a firm decision: US-001 and US-002 use worktrees (audit-main-crews, audit-main-ralph); US-003 uses the installed Copilot plugin cache. 'Operator can override' hedge removed. Open Questions reduced from 5 to 4 (the deferred decision removed; new OQ-3 about `copilot plugin install --from <path>` subcommand shape replaces the old deferral with a specific subcommand-fallback question).

findings.description: `copilot plugin install` mutates operator's Copilot plugin cache; no isolation.
findings.resolution: Constraint 10 + new AC-13 capture pre/post/restored Copilot plugin lists into preflight.json (copilotPluginListBefore, copilotPluginListAfter, copilotPluginListRestored). US-003 uninstalls ralph-overview at end; AC-13 asserts before==restored. Risk 11 documents the mitigation.

findings.description: Manifest-only test risks false PASS due to workspace .mcp.json fallback.
findings.resolution: US-003 now explicitly creates `scratch-mcp-session/no-workspace-mcp/` (no .mcp.json) for scenario 1 and `scratch-mcp-session/with-workspace-mcp/` for scenarios 2-3. Scenario 1 isolates plugin-manifest discovery from workspace discovery.

AC-1 dropped line-count threshold (now verifies topic branch + commit existence). AC-9 replaced line-count with required-subsection-count keyed to behavior IDs (crews 7, ralph 6, ralph-overview 5). AC-2 verifies ≥18 subsections across the report. AC-3 verifies every subsection has a Status row.

AC-4 now supplies an explicit awk verifier that asserts the two lines immediately after each `**Status:** FAIL` are `**File:** …` and `**Follow-up:** …` in strict order with no intervening blank line. Strict template format documented in US-004.

findings.description: Scratch-crew --state-cwd isolation buried in Open Questions.
findings.resolution: US-001 prose now opens with the explicit spawn-member command including `--state-cwd D:/harness-efforts/codexu/.ralph/jobs/plugins-copilot-cross-engine-audit/scratch-crew/`. Old Open Question #4 deleted (resolved).

Each story now captures observable evidence into `<job-dir>/evidence/` BEFORE scratch teardown. Risk 12 documents this. AC-10 explicitly says `evidence/` MUST remain after teardown. Evidence files enumerated in 'Files to Create/Modify'.

US-004 specifies a strict template: `### <id>-<name>`, `**Command:**`, `**Observed:**`, `**Evidence file:**`, `**Status:**`, optionally `**File:**` + `**Follow-up:**`. AC-9 verifies subsection counts; AC-3/AC-4 verify Status + FAIL-format.

findings.sectionRef: Acceptance Criteria > AC-2, AC-3, AC-5, AC-6
findings.resolution: All AC verification commands now use the full job-dir-relative path `.ralph/jobs/plugins-copilot-cross-engine-audit/audit-report.md` from cwd `D:/harness-efforts/codexu/`. AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5, AC-6, AC-9, AC-10, AC-11 updated.

US-002 now prefers 6 lighter direct-Node scenarios (codex-exec, copilot-exec, ralph.mjs --help, scripts/check-copilot-parity.mjs, mirror-prose grep). The full E2E /plan-with-ralph from a Copilot lead is now marked OPTIONAL with explicit fallback guidance.

findings.description: AC-10/AC-12 ordering on worktree clean status.
findings.resolution: AC-12 now requires `evidence/worktree-clean-status-{crews,ralph}.txt` captured BEFORE `git worktree remove`. AC-10 removes worktrees AFTER capture. AC-12 verifies both files exist and are empty.
